verdict.rationale: GitLab is well known for closing/referencing issues via commit message keywords (e.g. 'Closes #123'), but the evidence pack contains no documentation or reference to this issue-closing/status-update pattern via commit messages; only generic docs links and unrelated community commentary are present. missing for 10: docs on closing issue patterns in commits/MRs, evidence of automatic status transitions, any confirmation of the feature working in practice.
